{{Current events|year=2025|month=05|day=20|content=
<!-- All news items below this line -->
'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Somali Civil War (2009–present)|Somali Civil War]]
**[[Islamic State insurgency in Puntland]]
***[[Puntland counter-terrorism operations]]
****[[Puntland]] authorities confirm the killing of Ahmed Muse Said, a senior leader of the [[Islamic State – Somalia Province|Islamic State]] in [[Somalia]] who led the [[recruitment]] of members from local clans, during a security operation in the Togga Miiraale area of the [[Bari Region]], Puntland. [https://www.garoweonline.com/en/news/somalia/somalia-puntland-announces-death-of-senior-isis-facilitator-in-cal-miskaad-mountains (Garowe Online)] [https://www.hiiraan.com/news4/2025/May/201582/senior_isis_leader_killed_in_puntland_security_operation.aspx (Hiiraan Online)]
**[[2025 Mogadishu military base bombing]]
***[[Al-Shabaab (militant group)|Al-Shabaab]] claims at least six rounds of [[mortar (weapon)|mortar]] fire caused damage to properties in the [[Aden Adde International Airport]] area of Somalia's capital [[Mogadishu]], which includes the Halane base camp. The facility houses [[United Nations]] offices, [[African Union]] personnel, and [[List of diplomatic missions in Somalia|diplomatic missions]]. [https://www.garoweonline.com/en/news/somalia/somalia-mortar-attack-targets-mogadishu-international-airport-residents (Garowe Online)]
**[[2025 Shabelle offensive]]
***An Al-Shabaab mortar attack kills three [[Somali Armed Forces|Somali army personnel]] in Hiilweyne military [[barracks]] near [[Balad, Somalia|Bal'ad]] in [[Middle Shabelle]], [[Somalia]]. [https://www.hiiraan.com/news4/2025/May/201581/al_shabaab_launches_mortar_attack_on_halane_base_camp_in_mogadishu.aspx (Hiiraan Online)]
*[[Sudanese civil war (2023–present)|Sudanese civil war]]
**[[Battle of Khartoum (2023–2025)|Battle of Khartoum]]
***The [[Sudanese Armed Forces]] announces full control of [[Khartoum State]] following the withdrawal of the last remaining [[Rapid Support Forces]] units from the region. [https://apnews.com/article/sudan-war-military-rsf-khartoum-1c03cd653fd667a3c4f5c489bb644193 (AP)]
*[[Gaza war]]
**[[Israeli bombing of the Gaza Strip]]
***[[Israel Defense Forces|Israeli]] strikes kill at least 85 [[Palestinians]] in [[Gaza Strip|Gaza]]. [https://apnews.com/article/israel-palestinians-hamas-war-news-hostages-05-20-2025-402954f7424825ef73ad57f17a701fac (AP)]
*[[Mexican drug war]]
**Seven people are killed, including minors, in a [[mass shooting]] by [[Santa Rosa de Lima Cartel]] gunmen in [[San Felipe, Guanajuato|San Felipe]], [[Guanajuato]], [[Mexico]]. [https://www.cbsnews.com/news/mexico-mass-shooting-deaths-cartel-messages-guanajuato/ (CBS News)]

'''Arts and culture'''
*[[International Booker Prize]]
**Indian author [[Banu Mushtaq]] and translator [[Deepa Bhasthi]] win the [[International Booker Prize#2025|2025 International Booker Prize]] for ''[[Heart Lamp: Selected Stories|Heart Lamp]]'', a collection of short stories. [https://www.theguardian.com/books/2025/may/20/radical-translation-of-heart-lamp-by-banu-mushtaq-wins-international-booker-prize (''The Guardian'')]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*Four people are killed and two others are reported missing amid [[power outage]]s and widespread damage from [[flooding]] in [[Provence-Alpes-Côte d'Azur]], [[France]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/c8xgg82pr9no (BBC News)] [https://news.sky.com/story/three-dead-and-two-missing-after-floods-hit-southern-france-reports-13371867 (Sky News)]

'''International relations'''
*[[European Union–Russia relations]]
**The [[European Council]] adopts a 17th [[International sanctions during the Russian invasion of Ukraine|sanctions package]] against [[Russia]], including 189 additional vessels of Russia's [[Russian shadow fleet|shadow fleet]]. [https://enlargement.ec.europa.eu/news/eu-adopts-17th-sanctions-package-against-russia-2025-05-20_en (European Commission)]
*[[Israel–United Kingdom relations]]
**The [[United Kingdom]] suspends [[negotiation]]s on a new [[free trade agreement]] with [[Israel]] and summons the Israeli ambassador amid the recent Israeli offensive in [[Gaza Strip|Gaza]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/live/cq8037dd3p9t (BBC News)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[2025 New Orleans jailbreak]]
**A fifth escapee is captured in [[New Orleans]] following the largest [[jailbreak]] in [[United States]] history. Five escapees remain at large. [https://www.cbsnews.com/news/corey-boyd-new-orleans-inmate-captured-today/ (CBS News)]
*An attack in [[Mexico City]], Mexico, kills two of mayor [[Clara Brugada]]'s top aides. [https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cyvmm275j1go (BBC News)] [https://nos.nl/artikel/2568086-twee-medewerkers-van-burgemeester-mexico-stad-op-klaarlichte-dag-doodgeschoten (NOS)]
*Three students are injured in a [[mass stabbing]] attack at a school in [[Pirkkala]], [[Pirkanmaa]], [[Finland]]. The suspect, a 16-year-old, released a [[manifesto]] saying his target was women. [https://yle.fi/a/74-20162911 (Yle)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2025 Australian federal election]]
**The federal wing of the [[National Party of Australia|National Party]] leaves the [[Coalition (Australia)|Liberal-National Coalition]] for the first time since [[1987 Australian federal election|1987]], citing poor performance in the recent federal election and growing policy differences. [https://www.theguardian.com/australia-news/2025/may/20/nationals-leaving-split-coalition-liberal-party-australian-election (''The Guardian'' Australia)]
*[[2025 Bolivian general election]]
**Former [[Politics of Bolivia|Bolivian]] [[President of Bolivia|president]] [[Evo Morales]] fails to secure his candidacy for the [[presidential election]] as the deadline expires amid a court's decision to uphold his ban to run for a fourth term. Morales announces he will appeal the decision. [https://www.reuters.com/world/americas/evo-morales-out-bolivian-presidential-race-candidate-deadline-expires-2025-05-20/ (Reuters)]

'''Sports'''
*[[Chess]] [[Grandmaster (chess)|grandmaster]] [[Magnus Carlsen]] and 143,000 players draw in an [[online chess|online]] [[freestyle chess]] match on [[Chess.com]] lasting 46 days. The game sets a new record with the biggest number of opponents. [https://www.theguardian.com/sport/2025/may/20/chess-champion-magnus-carlsen-vs-the-world-match-ends-in-surprise-draw (''The Guardian'')]
